verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms developer.konghq.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a proper llms.txt index describing the docs corpus, and individual docs pages are consistently available in .md format (e.g. ai-providers.md, mcp.md), which is exactly the agent-oriented docs pattern this story asks for. missing for 10: no explicit first-party documentation page announcing/describing the llms.txt feature itself (only the probe confirms it), and no independent/community corroboration of agents actually consuming it.
